description:
Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

 OUR MISSION 

 True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

 OUR VALUES 

 
 Be the offset.   We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.

 What would it take?  We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.

 It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

 
 BENEFITS & PERKS *

 
 Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, with HSA/HRA options

 Generous time off: Flexible Time Off (FTO) for exempt employees, accrued PTO of up to 25 days for non-exempt employees, plus 12 paid holidays; Parental Leave; Sick Leave

 Fuel for your day: Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks for in-office employees

 And more: 401(k) retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, and Dog Fridays

 Equity participation: Equity is included as part of our total compensation package, giving you an opportunity to share in the company’s success.

 
 *Do not apply to fixed term and temporary roles

 YOUR MISSION  

 As a Software Engineer on the Digital Engineering team, you will help build, operate, and maintain the in-house software behind our digital thread — applications and services that keep product data connected across the product lifecycle and, over time, become the systems of record our teams work in every day. You'll ship real features across the stack from day one and work alongside senior and staff engineers who will invest in your growth. 

 You will learn the product-data domain — how requirements, design, PLM, ERP, manufacturing, and quality data connect — while contributing directly to delivery and operations. This is a high-growth role in a fast-paced environment where your work has immediate, visible impact. 

 This is an ideal role for an engineer early in their career or a few years in who is eager to learn, takes ownership, and wants to grow quickly alongside experienced engineers building something foundational. We're hiring at levels I through III; your level will be set based on your experience and interviews. 

 RESPONSIBILITIES  

 Build Across the Stack  

 
 Build features across the stack — services, APIs, data models, and web user interfaces — with guidance from senior engineers and growing independence over time. 

 
 
 Implement data flows, mappings, and workflow automation between our software and the engineering systems we use today. 

 
 
 Help migrate data and users onto in-house software as it replaces off-the-shelf tools. 

 
 
 Take on larger pieces of work as you grow — at level III, owning features end to end, from design through production. 

 
 Operate & Improve  

 
 Write tests, contribute to code reviews, and help keep our applications and services observable and reliable. 

 
 
 Help operate our software in production, including monitoring, triage, and resolving user-reported, sync, and data-quality issues. 

 
 
 Write clear technical documentation and grow your understanding of the engineering ecosystem and digital thread. 

 
 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS  

 
 Up to ~5 years of software development experience; internships, academic, or equivalent projects count for early-career candidates. 

 
 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

 
 
 Proficiency in at least one modern programming language and a willingness to work in our stack (e.g., Go, TypeScript). 

 
 
 Understanding of APIs, databases, web application fundamentals, and basic distributed-systems concepts. 

 
 
 Solid problem-solving skills and eagerness to learn the product-data domain. 

 
 
 Good written communication and collaboration habits. 

 
 
 U.S. Citizen or lawful permanent resident (U.S. Person) as required under ITAR. 

 
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS  

 
 Experience building web applications (e.g., TypeScript, React) through work, internships, coursework, or personal projects. 

 
 
 Exposure to system integrations, data pipelines, or event-driven services. 

 
 
 Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS), CI/CD, and testing practices. 

 
 
 Any exposure to PLM, ERP, manufacturing execution (MES), requirements/ALM, or MBSE systems. 

 
 
 Interest in aerospace, defense, or engineering data. 

 
 COMPENSATION  

 
 Denver, Colorado Base Salary: $70,000 – $160,000 

 
 
 Long Beach, California Base Salary: $75,000 – $165,000 

 
 
 Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave 

 
 Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience.  

 WORK ENVIRONMENT  

 
 This role operates in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment supporting national security space operations, where adaptability and rapid decision-making are essential. 

 
 
 Participation in an on-call and support rotation may be required as you grow into operating our software in production. 

 
 
 A supportive, mentorship-driven environment with room to take on increasing ownership. 

 
 
 Occasional travel to other company sites as needed. 

 
 ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS  

 
 Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance. 

 
 
 Work Location: this role is hybrid/onsite at our facilities in Denver, CO or Long Beach, CA. #LI-Onsite 

 
 
 Work environment is a standard office setting, working at a desk or on a production factory floor. 

 
 
 Physical demands may include frequent standing, sitting, walking, bending, and lifting or carrying items up to 20 lbs. 

 
 
 This position will be open until it is successfully filled. 

 
 To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. 

 True Anomaly is committed to equal employment opportunity on any basis protected by applicable state and federal laws. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us know.
